question: India joined the UNO in the year:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1945**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India joined the United Nations Organization (UNO) in the year **1945**.
 
• The UNO was established on **24th October 1945**, after World War II, to promote international cooperation and to prevent future conflicts.
 
• India was one of the original 51 founding members of the United Nations.
 
• India
